---
name: q1_0-wide-vlen-repack-rowparallel
description: "Decision to optimize Q1_0 matmul on wide VLEN (512-2048) via row-parallel Nx1 repack, not the q4_0_8x8 mmla-fold; recorded in opt_roadmap.md F4"
metadata: 
  node_type: memory
  type: project
  originSessionId: b6b76240-81f4-4da8-b28a-454652dff28c
---

For wide VLEN (512/1024/2048) the Q1_0 dot kernel's per-32 `vwredsum`
horizontal reduction wastes most lanes and gets relatively worse as VLEN
grows. Fix = repack + ROW-PARALLEL `Nx1` layout (blocklen=1, like
`ggml_gemv_q4_0_16x1_q8_0_generic` at repack.cpp:1370), NOT the `q4_0_8x8`
mmla-fold. N weight rows in N lanes; K-reduction becomes a loop-carried
vertical add per lane -> ZERO horizontal reductions.

**Why:** Q1_0 weights are +-1, so the multiply collapses to a conditional
add (`sumi = vsub_vx(sumi,y); sumi = vadd_vx_m(mask,sumi,2*y)` per column,
int16 accum, 32*127<32767 safe). The 8x8 path's vwmul + vnsrl fold tree is
pointless here (no dequant needed, and the fold IS a reduction).

**How to apply:** fix N=64, adapt LMUL to vlenb so fp32 acc is full
(VLEN=2048->m1, 1024->m2, 512->m4). Per-column vlm (128/block) is the main
tuning cost. Full design + inner loop + sub-features F4a-F4d in
`opt_roadmap.md` F4 (working tree, untracked). F4a = scalar reference +
kernel-lab test (TDD oracle, HW-agnostic) is the first step.

**ACE co-design (2026-07-20):** user confirmed int8 dot-product HW exists and
wants custom ACE-RVV instructions (COPILOT), not stock xandesvdot. Template =
their TQ1 ACE lab /local/nick/vsim-workspace/vsim-demo/ace-tq1 (unpack.ace:
`v_w_mul_free_macc` multiply-free widening MAC + trit unpack; tq1.c does
unpack -> macc -> ONE vwredsum/block because TQ1 pairs Q8_K 1-scale/256).
Chosen instruction = **A `v_q1_rowdot`**: `{io vrf:4int result, in vrf:int
activation, in vrf:uint signbits}`, per-lane 4-way sign-dot
`result[lane]+=sum_i(bit_i?+act_i:-act_i)`, activation broadcast, weights
1-bit from the Nx1 repack -> lanes=rows, NO reduction. Sign-bit analog of
VD4DOTS, HW = conditional-negate add-tree (no multiplier). Alternatives: C
`v_q1_sign_macc` (2int, single-row, keeps vwredsum), B `v_q1_unpack`+reuse
mul_free_macc (min HW). Full design + .ace sketch + build order in
opt_roadmap.md F6. Open: confirm COPILOT allows 4int in-lane reduce result
(v_q_tq2_unpack suggests yes). Asked user path A/B/C + activation format
2026-07-20; away, defaulting to A + keep per-32 Q8_0.

Related: [[ace-tq1-standalone-kernel-lab]], [[andesim-llamacpp-hybrid-gaps]].

content.text:
F4a 和 F4b 都完成了,完整 TDD 流程,所有測試綠燈。

**F4a - repack + scalar oracle(DONE)**

- `repack_q1_0_to_q1_0_64x1()`:64 row 的 `block_q1_0` 轉成 column-major 磚塊(`d[64]` + `qs[128][8]`,size 不變 1152B,有 static_assert 守著)
- `gemv_q1_0_64x1_q8_0_generic()`:保持和原 vec_dot 一模一樣的浮點運算順序
- TDD:先寫 `test_repack_gemv`(4 種 shape、random + 0x00/0xFF edge),stub 回 0 看到 RED,實作後 GREEN - **repack 後的 gemv 和逐 row 跑原始資料 bit-exact**,這就是 repack 正確性的證明

**F4b - RVV row-parallel GEMV(lab 完成,等 cycle gate)**

- `_vl512`(i16m2/f32m4,premium 的 FP-LMUL 上限)+ `_vl1024`(i16m1/f32m2)+ vlenb dispatcher
- scale 的 fp16->fp32 用整數位元運算展開(premium 沒有 zfh/zvfh,這條路是安全的)
- QEMU 4 個 VLEN 全過 double-ref gate(max_norm_err 2.7e-06,遠低於 1e-4)
- 組語驗過:inner loop 就是 3 條指令(`vlm` + `vsub.vx` + masked `vadd.vx`),無 spill

**一個要誠實講的數字**:QEMU proxy bench 在 K=51 shape(2560x1024)顯示 gemv 是 per-row vec_dot 的 0.73x - 看起來變慢。這是 TCG 對 masked op / 每 column 一次 vlm 收重稅的 artifact,跟當初 F2 被 QEMU 誤判是同一件事。指令數上 gemv 是 ~6 ops/row/block vs ~20,真正的裁判是 vsim cycle。

**下一步(擇一)**:

1. **ace-tq1 rdcycle standalone shootout** - 不用動 ggml,直接量 F4b kernel 的真實 cycle,最快拿到判決
2. **F4d 接進 ggml** - 然後跑 K=51 marker ROI,對決 premium 6528953 / fpga_l3 4476168 cycles

roadmap(F4 -> IN-PROGRESS,F4a/F4b 狀態)、kernel-lab README、tutorial 5.3、memory 都已同步。

---
name: ace-tq1-standalone-kernel-lab
description: "User's earlier standalone TQ1/TQ2 kernel extraction at /local/nick/vsim-workspace/vsim-demo/ace-tq1 - vsim baremetal, rdcycle, ACE custom instructions; techniques reusable for Q1_0/Q2_0 RVV work"
metadata: 
  node_type: memory
  type: reference
  originSessionId: a1f025b8-7f3c-4e04-8739-c3980abe86ac
---

/local/nick/vsim-workspace/vsim-demo/ace-tq1 is the user's earlier standalone
extraction of the TQ1_0 x Q8_K kernels (tq1.c, tq2.c), built for Andes vsim
baremetal (clang, -march=rv{XLEN}gc_zve32x_zfh, hvm_util malloc, enable_ace(),
mstatus VS-bit set in main).

Useful pieces for the llama.cpp Q1_0/Q2_0 RVV optimization (see
[[andesim-llamacpp-hybrid-gaps]] and opt_roadmap.md):

- Real cycle measurement: rdcycle() reads mcycle between kernel calls; vsim is
  cycle-accurate where QEMU only proxies instruction count. Flow: QEMU for
  correctness, vsim for cycles, FPGA final.
- Deferred-reduction pattern (roadmap F2): vwmaccsu accumulates i8 products
  into i16m2 lanes, ONE vwredsum per 256-block. Works there because TQ1_0/Q8_K
  have one scale per block; Q1_0 x Q8_0 must adapt (per-32 y scales).
- Trit unpack trick for ternary (roadmap F5 Q2_0): vmul by pow3 {3,9,27,81}
  then vwmulu x3 + vnsrl >>8 turns packed base-3 bytes into {0,1,2}.
- bsums offset trick: subtract sum(q8) once per block instead of handling the
  {0,1,2}->{-1,0,+1} offset per element (block_q8_K carries bsums).
- ACE custom instruction flow (roadmap F6+): unpack.ace spec -> COPILOT
  generates lib/libacetool.so (assembler plugin, objdump -Mace=...) and
  libaceasim.a (sim model); license.ini needed. Custom ops used:
  ace_v_q_tq1_unpack03_i32m4, ace_v_tq1_unpack4_i8m1,
  ace_v_w_mul_free_macc_i16m{2,8}.
- Caveat: its main() has no automated reference comparison (constant 1.0 test
  data, prints result only) - reuse the build/measure infra, not the
  verification; kernel-lab/ in llama.cpp repo has the proper harness.

# kernel-lab: standalone Q1_0 kernel verification

Extracts the Q1_0 x Q8_0 dot kernels out of ggml so one kernel can be built
and verified in isolation, without building llama.cpp.

## Files

- `q1_0.h` / `q1_0.c` - the kernels:
  - `ggml_vec_dot_q1_0_q8_0_generic` copied from `ggml/src/ggml-cpu/quants.c:127`
  - `ggml_vec_dot_q1_0_q8_0` (+ `_vl256`, `_vl128`) copied from
    `ggml/src/ggml-cpu/arch/riscv/quants.c:484` (`static` removed in the lab)
  - F4a: `repack_q1_0_to_q1_0_64x1` (row-major blocks -> column-major 64-row
    bricks) + `gemv_q1_0_64x1_q8_0_generic` scalar oracle (reference float-op
    order -> bit-exact vs per-row vec_dot on the original data)
  - F4b: `gemv_q1_0_64x1_q8_0` dispatcher + `_vl512` (i16m2/f32m4, premium)
    and `_vl1024` (i16m1/f32m2, fpga_l3) row-parallel RVV gemv - 3 vector
    ops per column, no reductions, no vector->scalar moves; per-row scales
    expanded fp16->fp32 with integer bit math (no zfh/zvfh, premium-safe)
  - fp16 conversion from `ggml/src/ggml-impl.h` (exact, table-free)
  - (the F2 defer-reduction candidates `_vl512`/`_vl512w` lived here until
    2026-07-22; removed - superseded by the F4 row-parallel repack)
- `test_q1_0.c` - harness comparing every kernel vs the scalar reference;
  `test_repack_gemv` gates F4a bit-exact and F4b by the double-ref bound;
  `--bench` adds a K=51-shape (2560x1024) whole-GEMV proxy (QEMU caveat below)

## Build and run

```
make host && ./test_q1_0_host            # x86: harness sanity (dispatcher==generic)
./test_q1_0_host --inject                # prove the harness detects a broken kernel
make rv64                                # cross build, static, RVV enabled
../run-rv64-qemu.sh $PWD/test_q1_0_rv64  # QEMU, VLEN=512 (vl256 path)
QEMU_CPU=andes-ax45mpv,vlen=256,zfh=true,zvfh=true ../run-rv64-qemu.sh $PWD/test_q1_0_rv64
QEMU_CPU=andes-ax45mpv,vlen=128,zfh=true,zvfh=true ../run-rv64-qemu.sh $PWD/test_q1_0_rv64  # vl128 path
../run-rv64-qemu.sh $PWD/test_q1_0_rv64 --bench   # per-kernel ns/row
make asm                                 # q1_0_rv64.s for LMUL/vl inspection
```

`--bench` under QEMU is NOT latency: qemu-user TCG charges a big fixed cost
per vector instruction, scalar instructions are nearly free, and pipeline
stalls do not exist. Cycle decisions need vsim (rdcycle, see the ace-tq1
flow) or FPGA; QEMU is for correctness.

## What "verified" means

1. **Bit-exact gate**: RVV result == scalar reference result, compared as raw
   float bits, over random + edge data (all-0/all-1 sign bits, q8 saturated
   +-127, zero scales) at sizes 128..8192. The current RVV kernels do the
   same float ops in the same order as the reference, so 0 tolerance applies
   (build uses `-ffp-contract=off` to keep both sides unfused).
2. **Double-reference gate**: |result - double_ref| / sum(|terms|) < 1e-4.
   This is the gate a future optimized kernel must pass when it reorders the
   float accumulation (the F4 row-parallel repack kernels will) and
   bit-exactness vs the reference no longer applies. The per-group integer
   sums must still be exact.
3. **Harness self-test** (`--inject`): flip one weight sign bit, require the
   kernel result to change. A harness that passes a broken kernel is worse
   than no harness.
4. **Cross-platform checksum**: the PRNG is deterministic, so the final
   result checksum must be identical on x86 host and QEMU at every VLEN.

## Data domain constraints (match ggml, do not "fix")

- `n % 128 == 0` (QK1_0); the ggml dispatcher guarantees this.
- q8 quants in [-127, 127]: ggml Q8_0 quantization never emits -128.
  The RVV kernel's `vneg` on int8 -128 would wrap to -128 while the scalar
  reference negates in 32-bit; feeding -128 produces a false mismatch.
- No NaN/Inf scales: real quantization never produces them, and NaN payload
  propagation may differ between fp16 conversion implementations.

stalls do not exist. Cycle decisions need vsim (rdcycle, see the ace-tq1
flow) or FPGA; QEMU is for correctness.

## What "verified" means

1. **Bit-exact gate**: RVV result == scalar reference result, compared as raw
   float bits, over random + edge data (all-0/all-1 sign bits, q8 saturated
   +-127, zero scales) at sizes 128..8192. The current RVV kernels do the
   same float ops in the same order as the reference, so 0 tolerance applies
   (build uses `-ffp-contract=off` to keep both sides unfused).
2. **Double-reference gate**: |result - double_ref| / sum(|terms|) < 1e-4.
   This is the gate a future optimized kernel must pass when it reorders the
   float accumulation (the F4 row-parallel repack kernels will) and
   bit-exactness vs the reference no longer applies. The per-group integer
   sums must still be exact.
3. **Harness self-test** (`--inject`): flip one weight sign bit, require the
   kernel result to change. A harness that passes a broken kernel is worse
   than no harness.
4. **Cross-platform checksum**: the PRNG is deterministic, so the final
   result checksum must be identical on x86 host and QEMU at every VLEN.

## Data domain constraints (match ggml, do not "fix")

- `n % 128 == 0` (QK1_0); the ggml dispatcher guarantees this.
- q8 quants in [-127, 127]: ggml Q8_0 quantization never emits -128.
  The RVV kernel's `vneg` on int8 -128 would wrap to -128 while the scalar
  reference negates in 32-bit; feeding -128 produces a false mismatch.
- No NaN/Inf scales: real quantization never produces them, and NaN payload
  propagation may differ between fp16 conversion implementations.

`--bench` 移除完畢,harness 重建全綠(host + rv64 無警告)。現在 `test_q1_0.c` 是純正確性測試,計時完全交給 vsim。

**`kernel-lab/test_q1_0.c` 在做什麼:**

它是所有 Q1_0 kernel 的**正確性裁判**。核心想法:每個優化 kernel 都要和「最笨但一定對」的 scalar reference 比答案。

**1. 假資料產生器**(`rng_next` / `fill_random`)
- xorshift PRNG,**種子固定** -> 每次跑、每個平台(x86 host、QEMU 各 VLEN)產生一模一樣的資料,結果才能跨平台對照
- 資料範圍模仿真實 ggml:q8 值在 [-127,127](ggml 從不產生 -128,-128 會讓 vneg 溢位造成假錯)、scale 在安全範圍

**2. 兩道關卡**(每筆測資都過)
- **bit-exact gate**:浮點運算順序和 reference 完全相同的 kernel(vl256、vl128、F4a scalar gemv),結果必須**每一個 bit 都一樣**(用 `f32_bits` 比原始位元)。build 加了 `-ffp-contract=off` 禁止 compiler 偷偷融合乘加,兩邊才公平
- **double-ref gate**:會重排浮點順序的 kernel(F4b RVV gemv,vfmacc 是融合乘加)不可能 bit-exact,改用 double 精度重算一次,要求正規化誤差 `|got - ref| / sum|每項|` < 1e-4

**3. 測試主體**
- `test_size`:每個長度(128 到 8192)跑 50 筆隨機 + 5 種邊界(sign bits 全 0 / 全 1、q8 全 +127 / 全 -127、weight scale = 0)
- `test_repack_gemv`:F4 的關卡 - 原始資料逐 row 跑舊 vec_dot 當期望值,repack 後跑 gemv,答案必須一致(scalar gemv 要 bit-exact,RVV gemv 過 double-ref)
- kernel 表帶 `min_vlen`:目前機器 VLEN 跑不動的 kernel 自動跳過(例如 VLEN=256 不會去跑需要 64 個 i16m2 lane 的 vl512 gemv)

**4. 自我檢測**(`--inject`)
- 翻轉**一個** weight sign bit,要求 dispatcher 的結果改變。這是在測「測試本身」- 一個連壞 kernel 都抓不到的 harness 比沒有 harness 更危險

**5. checksum**
- 所有 dispatcher 結果 XOR 起來印出。同一條 dispatcher 路徑下,host 和 QEMU 每個 VLEN 的 checksum 必須相同(現在是 `0x783be5d4`)

剛移除的 `test_bench` 就是你說的 QEMU instruction-count profiling - QEMU 的計時只反映 TCG helper 成本,會誤導(F2 的教訓),所以現在這個檔案**只管對錯,不管快慢**;快慢由 vsim 的 rdcycle harness(`vsim-demo/q1_0/main.c`)負責 - 那個還在 RTL sim 上跑,結果出來我會回報。

兩台 engine 的量測都上路了:

| engine | VLEN | before(原本) | after(優化) | 狀態 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sim_ax45mpv_premium` | 512 | `vl256` 逐 row x64 | `gemv_64x1`(i16m2/f32m4) | 跑步中 |
| `sim_ax46mpv_fpga_l3` | 1024 | 同一份 `vl256`(它不吃 VLEN) | `gemv_64x1`(i16m1/f32m2) | 跑步中 |

做法:kernel 3 用 `-DQ1_VLEN=1024` compile-time 切 LMUL(512 -> m2/m4,1024 -> m1/m2),兩個 binary:`test_q1_0`(premium)和 `test_q1_0_v1024`(fpga_l3),`make run` / `make run-1024` 對應。兩邊跑一樣的 workload(nr=64 x n=1024,K=51 的一條 strip),correctness 檢查也在裡面(vl256 要 bit-exact、gemv 容忍 fma 誤差)。

fpga_l3 的 RTL sim 比 premium 慢(有 L3 模型),要多等一下。三個背景 job(premium 舊 harness 對照、premium minimal、fpga_l3 minimal)結果出來我就整理成 before/after cycle 表格回報。

message.content: 什麼marker 版?

content.text:
Debug 用的土方法:在 main.c 裡埋「進度字母」,程式每走到一個階段就直接印一個字母。

背景:fpga_l3 前兩次 trap 死時,handler 給的資訊沒用(mepc=0),而且**連第一行 banner 都沒印出來**,所以我不知道它死在哪一步。於是:

```c
// 繞過 stdio,直接呼叫最底層的 _write 印一個字元
#define MARK(c) do { const char m = (c); _write(1, &m, 1); } while (0)

int main(void) {
    MARK('A');            // 進到 main 了
    iprintf("banner...");
    MARK('B');            // printf 活著
    ...填測試資料...
    MARK('C');            // 資料好了
    repack(...);
    MARK('D');            // repack 沒掛
    dot_scalar(...);  MARK('E');   // kernel 1 沒掛
    dot_vl256(...);   MARK('F');   // kernel 2(第一條 vector 指令)沒掛
    ...
    gemv_64x1(...);   MARK('H');   // kernel 3 沒掛
```

程式死掉時,看**印到哪個字母**就知道死在哪一段:例如印出 `ABC` 就死,代表掛在 repack;印到 `E` 就死,代表第一次跑 vector 指令(vl256)出事 - 可能是這顆 core 的 vector 沒開之類。

用 `_write`(最底層的輸出 system call)而不用 printf,是因為 printf 本身就是嫌疑犯之一 - 它內部要初始化 stdio、可能 malloc,如果兇手是它,用它來報案就永遠看不到輸出。

「marker 版」= 加了這些字母的 build。結果:加了 marker 之後這輪反而一直跑沒有死(前兩次 13 秒就 trap),所以它現在的價值變成:等它跑完,如果 ALL PASS,marker 拆掉收工;如果又 trap,字母會告訴我們死在哪一段。

message.content: 測試的 size 是多大 ? 為什麼要跑這麼久

content.text:
**Size 很小**:nr=64 x n=1024(K=51 那顆 2560x1024 矩陣的 1/40 條),權重 9 KB、activation 1 KB。

**慢的原因不是資料大,是 RTL simulator 本身**:vsim 是把 CPU 的邏輯閘一拍一拍模擬,速度只有 **~4000 cycles/秒**(真晶片是每秒十億拍,差 25 萬倍)。所以「模擬幾百萬 cycle」= 現實世界十幾分鐘。

而且諷刺的是,吃掉最多 cycle 的**不是要量的 kernel,是測試鷹架**:

```
估算 (cycles):
資料生成 (rng + fp16 轉換, 純 scalar)      ~200K
repack (scalar 一個 bit 一個 bit 搬)        ~600K   <- 跑兩次(一次用+一次計時)
scalar reference dot x64 rows (正確性裁判)  ~500K
--------------------------------------------------
真正要量的部分:
vl256 x64 rows x2 reps                      ~50K
gemv x2 reps                                ~20K
```

被量的 kernel 只佔總量的 ~5%,其他 95% 都是「準備資料 + 用最笨的 scalar code 算正確答案」- 但這些鷹架又不能省,因為正確性要在同一次執行裡驗。

幾百萬 cycle / 4kHz ≈ **10-20 分鐘一輪**,這就是為什麼 QEMU(快但 cycle 不準)和 vsim(準但慢)要分工:QEMU 管對錯已經驗完了,vsim 這裡其實只需要那 5% 的計時段。

如果 premium 那個舊 harness 對照組再拖著不出來,我會把它砍掉 - minimal 版涵蓋了它要證明的東西。要縮短等待也有招:把 correctness 段砍小(例如 scalar reference 只驗 8 個 row 而不是 64 個),鷹架成本會掉大半 - 等這輪結果出來如果要再迭代我就順手改。

流程修正完成,現在照你說的順序走:

**修好的東西:**

1. **premium 掛掉的真相**:PC trace 抓到它不是慢,是 **trap 了**,然後 trap handler 用的 `siprintf` 自己陷入無窮迴圈(在 `_svfiprintf_r` 掃字串),把 mcause/mepc 證據全吞掉。三次 premium run 全是這樣死的。

3. main.c 掛回單字元 marker(A/B/C/R,放在計時窗外)。

```
step 1  QEMU(裸機 wrapper):test_q1_0 @VLEN=512、test_q1_0_v1024 @VLEN=1024

step 2  QEMU 全綠之後,才上 vsim(premium + fpga_l3)拿 cycle
```

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Usage: run_qemu.sh <ELF_PATH> <VLEN> [--cwd DIR] [--readconfig CFG] [--timeout N] [EXTRA_FLAGS...]
set -uo pipefail

ELF_PATH="${1:?Usage: run_qemu.sh <ELF_PATH> <VLEN> [--cwd DIR] [--readconfig CFG] [--timeout N] [EXTRA_FLAGS...]}"
VLEN="${2:?Usage: run_qemu.sh <ELF_PATH> <VLEN> [--cwd DIR] [--readconfig CFG] [--timeout N] [EXTRA_FLAGS...]}"
shift 2

CWD=""
# Default to AX45MPV config — enables all RISC-V (Zba/Zbb/Zbc/Zbs/Zfh/Zvfh/Zfbfmin/Zvfbfmin/Zvfbfwma)
# and Andes extensions (zvqmac/vdot/vl4/vsih/vpfh/bf16cvt/codense) plus AE350 SoC settings.
# Override with --readconfig or --no-readconfig to disable.
READCONFIG="/home/nick/work/libnn/project/ax45mpv/qemu_cfg/zve64d/ADP-AE350-AX45MPV-1C_dw0_mw1.cfg"
TMOUT=60
EXTRA_FLAGS=""
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
        --cwd)           CWD="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --readconfig)    READCONFIG="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --no-readconfig) READCONFIG=""; shift ;;
        --timeout)       TMOUT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        *)            EXTRA_FLAGS+=" $1"; shift ;;
    esac
done

QEMU=/local/nick/qemu_andes/build/qemu-system-riscv64
TRACE=/tmp/qemu_trace.log

QEMU_FLAGS="-M andes_ae350 -cpu andes-ax45mpv,vext_spec=v1.0,vlen=${VLEN} -nographic -semihosting -bios ${ELF_PATH}"
if [ -n "$READCONFIG" ]; then
    QEMU_FLAGS="-readconfig ${READCONFIG} ${QEMU_FLAGS}"
fi

if [ -n "$CWD" ]; then
    cd "$CWD"
fi

timeout "$TMOUT" strace -f -e trace=write -o "$TRACE" \
  $QEMU $QEMU_FLAGS $EXTRA_FLAGS \
  > /dev/null 2>&1
RC=$?

# Extract semihosting output (fd varies: commonly 1 or 9)
grep -E 'write\((1|9),' "$TRACE" | grep '"' \

  | sed 's/\\n/\n/g; s/\\t/\t/g; s/\\r//g'

if [ "$RC" -eq 124 ]; then
  echo "[TIMEOUT after 60s]" >&2
fi
exit $RC

---

description: "two QEMU flavors in this env - qemu-runner agent is bare-metal qemu-system only; Linux binaries (kernel-lab tests, llama binaries) must use run-rv64-qemu.sh via Bash"
metadata:

Two incompatible QEMU flows exist for rv64 work (verified 2026-07-22):

- qemu-runner agent -> `/home/nick/.claude/agents/qemu-runner/run_qemu.sh` ->
  `qemu-system-riscv64 -M andes_ae350 -bios <ELF> -semihosting`. ONLY for
  bare-metal ELFs (ace-tq1 rdcycle style). Feeding it a Linux binary gives
  exit 1 with zero output. The agent is hard-constrained to one call of that
  wrapper and cannot run anything else. Wrapper takes VLEN as arg 2.
- `llama.cpp/run-rv64-qemu.sh` -> Andes `qemu-riscv64` user-mode. For Linux
  glibc binaries: kernel-lab/test_q1_0_rv64, llama-bench, etc. Output is
  normal stdout - no semihosting fd-9 quirk, safe to run directly in Bash.
  VLEN via env: `QEMU_CPU=andes-ax45mpv,vlen=256,zfh=true,zvfh=true`
  (zfh/zvfh must be explicit or fp16 SIGILLs).

to semihosting/bare-metal ELFs; following it for Linux binaries wastes an
agent round-trip and returns nothing.

-include ../Make.var

CC:=$(TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX)gcc
OBJDUMP:=$(TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX)objdump

# Toolchain DEFAULT runtime + -mvh (Andes virtual hosting): no custom
# crt0/libgloss/handler. The same ELF runs on Andes QEMU and on vsim.
# No zfh/zvfh in march: premium has neither; fp16 scales are expanded with
# integer vector ops (fp32 math needs zve32f).
CFLAGS:= -march=rv$(XLEN)gc_zve32f -mvh -O2 -ffp-contract=off -fno-tree-vectorize

# engines (use the vsim_andesim builds - RAM to 0x8fffffff, sim_control OK)
SIM_PREMIUM ?= /home/nick/work/vsim_andesim/build/sim_ax45mpv_premium
SIM_FPGA_L3 ?= /home/nick/work/vsim_andesim/build/sim_ax46mpv_fpga_l3

# vsim flavor: same sources, linked with the vsim BSP (sim_control MMIO I/O);
# vsim does not service -mvh virtual-hosting syscalls, QEMU does not model
# the sim_control device - hence one flavor per runner.
VSIM_LINK := $(VSIM_FILES) $(VSIM_FLAGS) $(VSIM_OPTIMIZE)

all: test_q1_0 test_q1_0_v1024 test_q1_0_vsim test_q1_0_vsim_v1024 test_q1_0.dump

# gemv built for VLEN=512 (i16m2/f32m4) - run on sim_ax45mpv_premium
test_q1_0: main.c q1_0.c q1_0.h
	$(CC) $(filter %.c,$^) -o $@ $(CFLAGS)

# gemv built for VLEN=1024 (i16m1/f32m2) - run on sim_ax46mpv_fpga_l3.
# Our objects avoid 'c' (ax46mpv has Zcmp, not Zcd: compressed FP stores are
# illegal there); prelinked libc is rv64gc, so stay on integer-only printf
# (iprintf) to keep libc's float-printf (which has c.fsdsp) out of the link.
test_q1_0_v1024: main.c q1_0.c q1_0.h
	$(CC) $(filter %.c,$^) -o $@ -DQ1_VLEN=1024 $(CFLAGS) -march=rv$(XLEN)g_zve32f

test_q1_0_vsim: main.c q1_0.c q1_0.h
	$(CC) $(filter %.c,$^) -o $@ $(CFLAGS) $(VSIM_LINK)

test_q1_0_vsim_v1024: main.c q1_0.c q1_0.h
	$(CC) $(filter %.c,$^) -o $@ -DQ1_VLEN=1024 $(CFLAGS) -march=rv$(XLEN)g_zve32f $(VSIM_LINK)

test_q1_0.dump: test_q1_0
	$(OBJDUMP) $< -d > $@

run: test_q1_0_vsim
	$(SIM_PREMIUM) $<

run-1024: test_q1_0_vsim_v1024
	$(SIM_FPGA_L3) $<

clean:
	- rm -f test_q1_0 test_q1_0_v1024 test_q1_0_vsim test_q1_0_vsim_v1024 *.o *.dump link.map

.PHONY: clean all run run-1024
